hero.name: Alejandro Repetto
hero.title: Software Engineer
hero.description:
I train teams to stop talking about AI and start executing with it. A 30-day sprint: diagnosis, applied training, and an internal hackathon.
Awarded at NASA Space Apps, ETH Argentina, and ETH Global.

bio.short: I train technical and executive teams to execute with AI, not just talk about it. Lecturer in the UCEL Diploma in applied AI, trainer at CRIA. Founder of NEXA. Background in competitive programming and cybersecurity.

background.title: Background
background.text:
I've been programming seriously since 2022, when I placed 6th in my first ICPC tournament. A 2024 winter training camp was a turning point that transformed how I approach technical challenges.

Today I'm a lecturer in the Diploma in AI applied to professional practice (UCEL), an AI trainer and consultant for companies at CRIA, and founder of NEXA (+3M people across +50 communities). I train teams mainly on Cursor and Grok Bot. I've also trained with Copilot and other tools.

My projects range from NASA Space Apps prediction algorithms to production systems with RAG architectures.

approach.title: Approach
approach.text: I'm very pragmatic. Competitive programming trained me to always analyze the time and space complexity of my projects, but the multiple hackathons I competed in taught me to build and validate MVPs fast, without losing sight of the architecture and distributed systems design that engineering gave me.

trainings.title: From talking about AI to executing with AI
trainings.lead: A 30-day sprint: diagnosis, applied training, and an internal hackathon. Your team leaves with prototypes, usage rules, and a 90-day roadmap.
trainings.proof: I have already trained +300 people in AI between CRIA and the UCEL Diploma in AI applied to professional practice. I train teams mainly on Cursor and Grok Bot.
